observations: Photo 0: Silver double-cab pickup, front view, Toyota emblem on grille, honeycomb grille style, daytime running lights on, windshield has small sticker/tag, no model badge readable here.
Photo 1: Same truck, front 3/4 view, aftermarket-style black wheels, windshield has handwriting that is partially legible.

Photo 2: Rear view, tailgate reads 'TACOMA' and 'V6' badge visible, tonneau cover fitted, tow hitch present. Rear window glass has clearly handwritten text reading 'No Start 963' in white marker/chalk.
No TRD badge, no moonroof, no interior, no VIN plate, no odometer, and no engine bay are visible in any of the 3 photos.
Handwritten 'No Start' notation on the rear glass is consistent with an auction/import yard condition tag (e.g. US salvage/export auction lot marking).

claims.evidence: No VIN, plate, or build sticker visible in any photo.
No import/duty paperwork or plate shown.
V6 badge visible on tailgate (photo 2), but no TRD badge or 4x4 badge visible in any photo.
No roof or interior photo provided.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened, works perfectly
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows handwritten 'No Start 963' on the rear glass, a typical auction-lot marking indicating the vehicle did not start at time of lot entry.

risks.risk: Vehicle may not start / engine or electrical failure
risks.proof: Video of key-start with engine running and idling

risks.risk: Possible flood, accident, or frame damage typical of US auction imports
risks.proof: Undercarriage, engine bay, and full VIN/Carfax or auction report photos

risks.risk: Duty/customs status unverified, risk of seizure or back-duty owed
risks.proof: Photo of duty certificate matching chassis number

risks.risk: TRD trim and features (moonroof, push-start) unconfirmed, may be base trim misrepresented
risks.if_unproven: priced as base trim without those features

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running (addresses the 'No Start' marking directly)
Clear photos of VIN plate, dashboard odometer, and duty/customs certificate
Interior photos showing push-to-start button and moonroof
Full exterior walk-around including undercarriage and engine bay
response.reason: The seller claims the truck 'works perfectly' and is 'like new, never repaired or opened,' but the seller's own rear-view photo shows a handwritten 'No Start' auction tag on the rear glass, directly contradicting the working-condition claim.
